reuse.why: Hooks into the existing refuseIfAlreadyLinked wrapper shared by every link handler, but copies unlinkAccount's field reset instead of extracting a local-unlink helper both could use.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block that clears account_id/bank/balances/sync source/status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount.

placement.why: Putting the takeover in the shared link wrapper reaches every provider, but a function named and documented as a refusal guard now performs writes, and it unlinks before the wrapped handler has succeeded.

scope.why: Only the param type, the wrapper and a release note change.

maintainability.why: The copied unlink reset will drift from unlinkAccount if unlinking ever clears another field, and the guard's name/comment no longer describe what it does.

bypasses_abstraction.where: refuseIfAlreadyLinked in server/accounts/app.ts re-implements the local part of unlinkAccount instead of sharing it
